title: Prompt logging and evidence-based progress tracking

acceptance.evidence: 125 ordered items across 26 packages include explicit owners/how/files/verification/dependencies/evidence; seven future tracks retain activation blockers.
acceptance.how: Each small item has an owner, prerequisites, how-to, files, verification and explicit errors/evidence.
acceptance.verification: Checklist state and dependencies validate; false completion is rejected.

acceptance.evidence: README summary and detailed PROGRESS board are generated; focused member/task commands and checklist updates exist.
acceptance.how: Keep detailed steps on PROGRESS and a short member/next-action summary on README.
acceptance.verification: Regeneration is deterministic and current next actions reflect actual prerequisites.

acceptance.evidence: Command-only classification, discussion rejection, batch rollover and outcome amendment tests pass.
acceptance.how: Require implementation/commit/push kind; exclude discussion and preserve short batches.
acceptance.verification: Discussion calls fail without writes; 50-entry rollover and amendments pass tests.

acceptance.evidence: Three-field PR template, event verifier and six-member unconfirmed registry exist; account/tool/approval inference is rejected by tests.
acceptance.how: Use a three-field PR declaration and observed GitHub account evidence; never infer AI tools or human names.
acceptance.verification: Manual and AI declarations validate; unmapped identity remains unconfirmed.

acceptance.text: Test the workflow and hand it off
acceptance.evidence: 46 helper tests pass; local checks are recorded. Remote CI and human review have not run.
acceptance.how: Run all helper tests and record/link checks; document local/remote CI and review limits.
acceptance.verification: Tests pass; independent review/main-branch delivery remain explicit.
